newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends lower on late dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends lower on late dlr demand.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed lower against the dollar on Monday due to short covering and some late commercial dollar demand, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 58.60 to the dollar, after opening at 58.62 and falling to 58.61.
"There was some short covering and late commercial demand for the dollar, but speculators were on the sidelines," said a Deutsche Bank dealer.
"Speculators were cautious due to the dollar's overseas strength," he added.
The Central Bank pushed up the dollar by four local cents due to its overseas strength and fixed buying and selling prices at 58.5263 and 59.7087.
Overnight call money closed at 8.875 percent, with the Central Bank's overnight repo rate at 8.75 percent.
